description: Report the calling organization's plan, the free quota it has left this period and the day the quota renews, its balance, the credits its agents' tasks hold and what is left available to spend, the coverage it has left for the current period, the per-call limits in force, how many projects it holds revealed and how many profile parts it currently holds. Free. Consult it before planning a wide search: coverage limits how many new entities you can see in a period; the free quota and the available credits (the balance less what agents' tasks hold) limit what you can pay for. What the tools accept and charge for is in capabilities.
name: usage
title: Plan, quota, balance and limits
